chain.title: Prepare the logic-chip ingredients
chain.desc: Craft Raw Logic Chips using the installed recipe. A small batch supports the first two nodes, cards, and setup tool.

chain.title: Fire the network components
chain.desc: Smelt the raw chips into Logic Chips. Keep spare chips for filters and cards when the first route is working.

chain.title: A relay between nodes
chain.desc: Craft Laser Connectors for intermediate network links. Connectors relay links; the Laser Node beside an inventory is the block that holds cards and interacts with it.

chain.title: Put a node beside the inventory
chain.desc: Place Laser Nodes next to the source and destination blocks. Open the correct node face for the adjacent block and configure cards on that face.

chain.title: Link the intended endpoints
chain.desc: Use the Laser Wrench to link nodes and connectors. Check the visible connection network and supported distance before configuring a long route.

chain.title: Set up item extraction and insertion
chain.desc: Configure Item Cards on the source and destination faces, using compatible channels and the intended Extract/Insert modes. Test one stack before enabling a continuous supply.

chain.title: Test the complete item route
chain.desc: Link the two nodes, configure the source and destination cards, and move a test stack into the intended inventory. Confirm this milestone after the transfer works.

chain.title: Keep the route selective
chain.desc: Configure a Basic Filter and install it in the appropriate card. Verify allow-list or deny-list behavior before connecting mixed storage.

chain.title: Carry configured cards together
chain.desc: Use a Card Holder to organize the cards needed for the next network section. Label or separate the planned configurations so building a new route stays manageable.

chain.title: Improve a card's throughput
chain.desc: Install Card Overclockers in a working card to improve its supported transfer behavior. Check both amount and interval, and make sure the receiving machine can accept the faster supply.

chain.title: An independent energy channel
chain.desc: Configure Energy Cards between an actual source and consumer. Set the channel, direction, and energy-limit behavior deliberately; the cards move energy rather than producing it.

chain.title: An independent fluid channel
chain.desc: Configure Fluid Cards on tank or machine faces. Use filters and appropriate channels so the network sends the intended fluid to each destination.

chain.title: Control a machine through the network
chain.desc: Configure Redstone Cards to read and output the intended signal. Test both states before using the route to control a valuable production process.

chain.title: Stock a measured ingredient amount
chain.desc: Use a Count Filter with the appropriate card mode to maintain the intended quantity. Test how restocking reacts to consumed items and a full receiving inventory.

chain.title: Match a family of ingredients
chain.desc: Configure a Tag Filter using a real installed item or fluid tag. Inspect the matching entries so an overly broad tag does not route unintended materials.

chain.title: Sort by the producing mod
chain.desc: Use a Mod Filter when a route should accept a selected mod's items. This is a sorting choice, not a replacement for ingredient-specific filters in a recipe machine.

chain.title: Distinguish items with stored data
chain.desc: Configure an NBT Filter when item state matters, such as enchantments or stored contents. Test the actual matching behavior with two different examples before enabling the route.

chain.title: Let more cards work together
chain.desc: Use Node Overclockers when the node needs more cards to operate in the same tick. Card overclockers improve individual transfer behavior; the node upgrade addresses simultaneous card work.

chain.title: Pair a distant network link
chain.desc: Link a pair of Advanced Connectors for a remote connection, including across dimensions where supported. Each advanced connector has one partner; linking another replaces the old pair.

chain.title: Repeat a proven configuration
chain.desc: Use the Card Cloner to copy a tested card configuration onto compatible cards. Review faces, channels, and filters at the new location before enabling the copied route.

notes: Re-reviewed 2026-10-07 against local Minecraft 1.20.1 JAR item assets and selected recipes/manuals, with official project sources listed separately. Every authored row now has explicit prerequisites; empty lists identify intentional branch roots. The coverage section states the verified versions and remaining limits. This replaces older list-order and item-count claims.

coverage.scope: Authored branched progression; item and component acquisition objectives, not automatic proof that a factory works.
milestones: Independent energy, fluid, and redstone cards
limits: Modes are card configuration, not separately registered items.
Corrects legacy guide claims: connectors do not replace inventory-adjacent nodes; advanced pairs are not merely chunk-boundary extenders.
Pack scripts, recipe changes, and other Minecraft versions require the installed-pack scan; this guide is not a complete mod manual.
coverage.verification: Local JAR item models and English registry names; selected recipes and bundled manuals checked. Not a new in-game playthrough.
